name: Payment arrangement code
description: Code specifying the arrangements for a payment.

values.name: Payable elsewhere
values.description: Payable elsewhere Responsibility for payment of transport charges unknown at time of departure.

values.name: Third party to pay
values.description: Third party to pay A third party to pay the freight bill is known at the time of shipment.

values.name: Collect
values.description: Collect Charges are (to be) collected from the consignee at the destination.

values.name: Prepaid
values.description: Prepaid Charges are (to be) prepaid before the transport actually leaves.
